title: RPxSB's latest single, "Red Eye" ft. Nomadic is a standout track
htmlContent:
RPxSB's latest single, "Red Eye," ft. Nomadic is a standout track from their collaborative album "Shaggy Carpets." The San Francisco rap duo has seamlessly blended their raw, honest lyrics with soulful, vintage-inspired beats. The track showcases the duo's impressive skills on the mic as they share their experiences of navigating life's challenges. Nomadic's production perfectly complements RPxSB's style, creating a nostalgic and dreamy soundscape that transports the listener to a different time.

The "Red Eye" music video adds another layer to the captivating track. Directed by Yung Chavo, the video features stunning visuals that perfectly capture the song's essence. The video's hazy, neon-lit scenes perfectly complement the lyrics, creating a dreamlike atmosphere that draws the viewer in.

RPxSB's authenticity and honesty shine through in "Red Eye" and the rest of "Shaggy Carpets." The album is a must-listen for fans of vintage-inspired hip-hop and anyone looking for raw and genuine storytelling.
